[1/6] subject_definitions
────────────────────────────────────────

<Picture 1> A portrait reference sheet of a young Chinese woman in her early 20s, featuring a six-panel layout: three close-up head shots (front / three-quarter / side profile) and three full-body shots (front / three-quarter / back). She has long dark brown slightly wavy hair with a center part, delicate facial features, refined cool-toned makeup, soft pink lips, a subtle jade-pale complexion, and sharp yet gentle eyes. She wears long tassel drop earrings, a thin plain silver pendant necklace without any engraved text, an off-the-shoulder white ruched mini dress with a sweetheart neckline and delicate ruffled trim along the bust (no printed logos, brand names, letters, or character graphics), and white ankle-strap pointed-toe stiletto heels (no visible brand markings). The reference sheet has a clean light gray backdrop and bottom-row caption reading "编号：LH-001　姓名：畅颜　年龄：21岁　气质：清冷御姐".

<Subject 1> The Chinese woman from <Picture 1>. She is LH-001, named Changyan, 21 years old, archetype: the "清冷御姐" (cool elegant queen) — a poised, aloof, sophisticated young woman with an inherent sense of emotional distance and icy elegance. Her long dark brown wavy hair, off-shoulder white mini dress, tassel earrings, and silver pendant necklace define her silhouette.

<Subject 2> The setting is a high-rise penthouse at night, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a vast city skyline. The windows reveal countless distant city lights and the moon casting a soft silhouette across the skyline. Inside, the room is dimly lit with warm tungsten side lighting, the city glow filtering in as cool backlight to sculpt her silhouette. The atmosphere is intimate, cinematic, and quietly luxurious — minimalist interior with no visible text, logos, or printed graphics anywhere in the frame.

<Audio 1> Background music track: minimal cinematic piano + sustained sub-bass, low-energy atmospheric bed that does not overpower the spoken vocals. Piano arpeggios align with the cadence of the spoken intro, sub-bass sustains gently throughout. Music gently fades out by 0:11.

<Audio 2> Voice persona reference for the spoken intro vocal: chest-dominant resonance + air-thin breath + cold-metallic timbre + 0.6× slow tempo + flat-stable emotional arc + sentence-tail-drop signature. A 21-year-old Chinese female voice with cool, aloof, polished delivery — clear diction, controlled low-mid register, distant and unfazed. Each sentence lands with weight and ends with a slight downward drop, never rising. Pauses between sentences are measured and silent. No vocal fry, no breathy gasps, no smile leakage in the tone.

────────────────────────────────────────
[2/6] summary
────────────────────────────────────────

A 12-second 9:16 vertical-format cinematic self-introduction video of Changyan (LH-001, 21-year-old "清冷御姐" archetype) standing center-frame against a high-rise night cityscape. The arc follows six shots — entering medium hold, dolly-in transition, frontal medium opening greeting, face close-up self-confirmation, held close-up persona reveal, and a slow-blink signature sign-off — speaking her self-introduction directly to camera in cool-toned Chinese Mandarin, ending with a single complete slow blink (close + open + linger) as her signature closing gesture.

────────────────────────────────────────
[3/6] retention_analysis
────────────────────────────────────────

Character identity (face, age, clothing, hair, accessories) from <Picture 1> is fully_preserved across all six shots — no face drift, no wardrobe change, no age shift, no expression washout.

Background environment is fully_preserved — the high-rise penthouse night cityscape in <Subject 2> remains consistent across all six shots with stable lighting and window composition.

Voice identity from <Audio 2> is fully_preserved — the chest-dominant, air-thin, cold-metallic, 0.6× tempo, sentence-tail-drop delivery remains consistent throughout the spoken intro, without drifting to a generic female tone.

The complete slow-blink signature (close + open + linger) at 0:10.5–0:12 must remain intact and clearly readable — not reduced to a mere glance or softened micro-expression.

No visible text of any kind appears anywhere in the frame at any time.

────────────────────────────────────────
[4/6] detailed_description
────────────────────────────────────────

[Zero-Text Global Constraint] No visible text of any kind appears anywhere in the frame at any time — no watermarks, logos, brand text, platform badges, social media handles, URLs, QR codes, timestamps, subtitles, captions, or any other on-screen text. The frame contains only the character, the penthouse environment, and pure image elements. All clothing is plain and free of any printed logos, brand names, letters, or character graphics.

[3-Stage Emotion Curve]
- Stage 1 — Pre-Speech Preparation (0:00–0:02): alert poise + gaze focus, no smile leakage.
- Stage 2 — Core Delivery (0:02.5–0:10.5): guarded-courteous → sincere self-confirmation → slow persona reveal.
- Stage 3 — Signature Sign-Off (0:10.5–0:12): complete slow-blink (close + open + linger) as her signature gesture.

[Shot 1 — Entering Medium Hold, 0:00–0:02] Locked-off frontal medium shot of Changyan standing center-frame, perfectly still with both feet planted and shoulder-width apart, hands resting naturally at her sides. She wears the off-shoulder white ruched mini dress, silver pendant necklace, and tassel earrings from <Picture 1>. The high-rise cityscape glows softly behind her through floor-to-ceiling windows, casting a cool silhouette rim light while warm tungsten side lighting sculpts her face. During this 2-second opening, her pupils slowly gather focus toward the lens (the unconscious instant of "locking on"), her upper eyelids settle ever so slightly into an alert but calm poise, she takes one measured inhale (a subtle rise of the collarbone), and her right hand lifts a fraction to brush a single strand of hair behind her right ear — the silver pendant catches a brief glint of light. No smile. No movement of feet.

[Shot 2 — Dolly-In Transition, 0:02–0:02.5] A smooth 0.5-second dolly-in pushes from frontal medium to upper-torso framing. Her gaze arrives at the lens first, the lens arrives at her a beat later. Her lips part a fraction as she prepares to speak — the very first micro-inhale before the first syllable. No smile leakage. No head tilt yet.

[Shot 3 — Frontal Medium Opening Greeting, 0:02.5–0:06.5] Frontal medium shot holds. She speaks the opening line of her self-introduction in a controlled chest-dominant, air-thin, cold-metallic voice at 0.6× tempo, sentence-tail-drop. Her delivery is courteous but not warm — this is "stranger-greeting" guarded politeness, not friendly warmth. Her pupils subtly narrow (the pupil micro-shrink of "I see a stranger"), her upper eyelids hold in calm control (no exaggerated widening, no eye-bulging), and the corners of her lips lift only the faintest degree — a polite smile that never reaches the orbicularis oculi muscle (the eye muscle that activates a real smile remains still, signaling this is courtesy, not joy). Each sentence lands with weight and ends with a slight downward drop. Her head makes no more than a micro-tilt of two degrees toward camera-right between phrases.

<d>[Chinese] 大家好！我是畅颜。</d>

[Shot 4 — Face Close-Up Self-Confirmation, 0:06.5–0:08.5] The lens pushes into a face close-up. She delivers the second segment of her self-introduction in the same controlled cold-metallic voice. This is "sincere self-confirmation" — her eyes focus intently on the lens, her pupils perform a slight contraction (the micro-pupil-shrink of genuine seriousness), and her masseter muscles tighten just enough to slightly compress her lower lip line, revealing the unspoken digest of stating her own identity aloud. Her lips articulate each syllable with precise clarity. No smile leakage. No emotional theatrics.

<d>[Chinese] 编号 001，21 岁。</d>

[Shot 5 — Held Close-Up Persona Reveal + Invite, 0:08.5–0:10.5] Held face close-up. She delivers the third segment — the persona tag and the invite. The emotional pivot is "slow persona reveal." When the words "清冷御姐" land, her upper eyelids settle half a degree lower over the course of 0.2 seconds — the "inch-by-inch" slow descent that signals her cool-aristocrat identity emerging (per the honesty hierarchy: emotion lives in the eyelids, not the mouth). The corners of her mouth rise only at the very last fraction of a syllable, an "extremely slow, one-inch-at-a-time" pull rather than a sudden smile. As she speaks the phrase "喜欢我" (please follow me), her gaze momentarily flicks down for a fraction of a second toward the silver pendant resting at her collarbone — that brief flick is the "prop-as-emotion-switch": the inner thaw of inviting someone to follow her, made visible through a flash of glint on the pendant. Her gaze then returns to the lens. No vocal fry. No breathy gasps. No smile leakage.

<d>[Chinese] 是自带疏离感的清冷御姐，喜欢我，请多多关照哦。</d>

[Shot 6 — Slow-Blink Signature Sign-Off, 0:10.5–0:12] Held close-up pulls out slightly into a frontal medium hold. As her final syllable lands, she performs the complete signature gesture of the "清冷御姐" archetype: a single, slow, deliberate blink. The blink is divided into three deliberate beats — 0.5 second slow full closure (her eyelids descend in the cool, controlled manner of a queen who closes her eyes on her own terms), 0.5 second slow re-opening (the eyelids lift, revealing her cool, settled gaze once more), and 0.5 second of lingering stillness (the orbicularis oculi has fully relaxed, the orbicularis oris has fully relaxed, the face is at rest — a porcelain-still queen). Her expression does not change to a smile. Her feet do not move. Her hands do not lift. The city lights behind her settle into their final glow. The frame holds her in this lingering stillness as the music gently fades out.

────────────────────────────────────────
[5/6] overall_soundscape
────────────────────────────────────────

The ambient sound bed is composed of three layers. Layer one is the room tone of the high-rise penthouse interior — a quiet, soft hush of a well-insulated space at night, with the barely perceptible low-frequency hum of building HVAC at -50dB. Layer two is the cityscape heard through the floor-to-ceiling windows — distant, heavily damped urban night sounds: the soft murmur of far-off traffic, occasional distant car horns at -40dB, and the occasional muted whoosh of a far-off high-altitude aircraft. Layer three consists of intimate micro-action sounds from the character herself: the faint rustle of the ruched dress fabric during the opening strand-of-hair movement at 0:01, the tiny metallic tap of her tassel earring swinging gently at 0:04, and the very faint whisper of breath between phrases (the breath-pause micro-sounds that punctuate her measured delivery). No music is included in this layer — music is reserved for non_diegetic_music. No diegetic TV, radio, or background conversation is present. No vocal fry or throat noise. No reverb tail.

────────────────────────────────────────
[6/6] non_diegetic_music
────────────────────────────────────────

A single 12-second background music track plays underneath the entire video, fading in from 0:00 and gently fading out by 0:11. The track is built from two elements. Element one is a minimal cinematic piano line — sparse, single-note arpeggios in a cool D-minor tonality, with one note landing precisely on each beat of the character's spoken cadence (the piano note at 0:03 lands exactly on her "大家好", the piano note at 0:07 lands exactly on her "编号", the piano note at 0:09 lands exactly on her "清冷", and the piano note at 0:11 lands exactly on the moment her slow-blink closes). Element two is a sustained sub-bass drone in low D, playing continuously from 0:00 to 0:11 at -25dB, providing a constant cool low-end foundation. The track has no drum hits, no percussion, no vocals, no melodic climax, and no ornamental flourishes — it is a flat, cool, atmospheric bed that never rises above -20dB so as to never compete with or mask the character's spoken voice. No jingles, no stings, no musical accents at the closing frame. The piano arpeggio and sub-bass simply drift into silence by 0:11, leaving the final 1 second of frame to be filled only with room tone and the quiet afterglow of the cityscape.
